To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a mixing weight determination approach for retrieving optical properties (e.g., AODmixture, SSAmixture and SSAsoot) of polluted dust is developed and validated with AERONET observations.
the developed algorithm is able to provide spatially variant dust-soot mixing weight, and improve the retrieval accuracy of AOD and SSA of polluted dusts.
the effective mixing weight can be retrieved from satellite remote sensing data, and the retrieved effective mixing weight can improve the accuracy in AOD and SSA retrievals for dust–soot mixtures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mixing weight determination for retrieving properties of polluted dusty aerosols.

the retrieval of optical properties of dust–soot polluted aerosol with MODIS and ground-based measurements, providing a promising method to monitor the mixing weights and properties of polluted dust in the Middle East.
the retrieval of the effective mixing weight of dust–soot mixture aerosols from satellite remote sensing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach in this study can be a useful tool in improving the accuracy of retrieving the optical properties of polluted dusty environments with satellite remote sensing data.
the proposed approach in this study is a promising way to retrieve the mixing weights of dust and soot in dust–soot mixtures and to improve the retrieval accuracy of the properties of polluted dust.
the proposed approach in this study is a feasible and effective way to improve the accuracy and applicability of retrieving polluted dust properties from satellite remote sensing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the mixing weights of soot aggregates can be retrieved with the proposed approach and the retrieved AODmixture can provide a better constraint for the retrieval of SSA, which is essential for the retrieval of soot optical properties.

the proposed approach can provide a more accurate retrieval of the polluted dust properties with the consideration of spatially variant dust mixing weights, which can be applied to the other regions where dusts are mixed with soot particles.
the approach proposed in this study could provide the spatial distribution of soot mixing weight and improve the accuracy of satellite remote sensing for dust properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the spatial distribution of dust–soot mixtures should be taken into account when retrieving the optical properties of dusts with satellite remote sensing.
the mixing weight of soots can be retrieved with the developed algorithm and the spatially variant mixing weight of sooths could improve the retrieval accuracy.

, the mixing weight of sooty dust can be retrieved from satellite remote sensing data with the proposed algorithm, and it can be used for improving the retrieval accuracy of polluted dust optical properties.
